produtos.title: Post Alpha Cooling Peptide Ampoule
produtos.body:
Cell Fusion C Post Alpha Cooling Peptide Ampoule is a lightweight cooling ampoule that instantly lowers skin temperature, tightens the look of pores, and helps keep skin looking firm and healthy against daily heat stress.

Instant Cooling, Lasts 1 Hour
Drops skin temperature by -6.5°C* the moment it touches skin, delivering a refreshing and gentle coolness that helps keep overheated skin comfortable for up to 1 hour.

Visibly Tighter Pores
Targets 10 types of pore concerns—including enlarged, loose, and melanin-clogged pores—caused by daily heat exposure, for a noticeably smoother and more refined skin surface.

Daily Defense Against Heat Stress
Repeated exposure to heat can accelerate visible signs of aging. This ampoule helps support skin's resilience against daily heat stress, keeping skin looking firm and healthy over time.

Dewy, Glass-Like Finish
The lightweight, water-blue essence absorbs instantly, leaving skin with a smooth and naturally dewy finish—never sticky or heavy.

Cooling + Pore Care + Brightening in One
Formulated with COOL-ing HA™, Glacial Water, and Acetylhexapeptide-8, this multitasking ampoule addresses cooling, pore elasticity, and skin tone in a single step.

produtos.title: Toning C Vita Retinal Eye Cream
produtos.body:
Cell Fusion C Toning C Vita Retinal Eye Cream is a clinically tested anti-aging eye cream powered by Vita Retinal 5% Complex—a triple-coated Retinal Liposome enhanced with Vitamins C & E—that targets four visible signs of aging around the eyes: lines, dark spots, dark circles, and puffiness.

Retinal: One Step Stronger Than Retinol
Unlike Retinol, Retinal activates in just one step—working faster and more efficiently deep within the skin to support collagen production and visibly reduce fine lines. Deep wrinkles around the eyes improved by 19.55%, smile lines by 32.83%, and neck lines by 13.24% in 4 weeks.*

Not Just Retinal—Vita Retinal 5% Complex
A triple-coated Retinal Liposome enhanced with Vitamins C & E and Adenosine for deeper ingredient delivery. The layered liposome structure ensures lasting stability and maximum efficacy—targeting both wrinkles and dark circles at the source.

Visibly Brighter, Spot-Free Eye Area
Pure Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) and Niacinamide work together to fade dark spots and uneven pigmentation around the eyes. Dark spots improved by 16.86% in 4 weeks,* and 100% of users reported a brighter-looking eye area.**

Reduces Dark Circles
95% of users saw visibly reduced dark circles** — with Vitamins C & E delivered directly to the under-eye area via the triple-coated liposome complex.

De-Puffs Tired Eyes
